apiVersion.description: APIVersion defines the versioned schema of this representation of an object.

kind.description: Kind is a string value representing the REST resource this object represents.

keycloakCRName.description: The name of the Keycloak CR to reference, in the same namespace.

labels.description: Optionally set to add additional labels to the Job created for the import.

placeholders.description: Optionally set to replace ENV variable placeholders in the realm import.

realm.description: The RealmRepresentation to import into Keycloak.

resources.description: Compute Resources required by Keycloak container. If not specified, the value is inherited from the Keycloak CR.
